# DOPPLERGEIST

> Source-available Python software for comparing aircraft Doppler signatures in recordings with historical ADS-B flight paths. DOPPLERGEIST runs locally and reports inconclusive searches when the available evidence does not support a location.

- [Canonical project website](https://itsdavis.com/DOPPLERGEIST/)
- [Source code and license](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/DOPPLERGEIST)
- [Python package](https://pypi.org/project/dopplergeist/)
- [How to cite the software](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/DOPPLERGEIST/blob/main/CITATION.cff)

## Documentation in Markdown

- [Overview](https://itsdavis.com/DOPPLERGEIST/index.md): What the project does and how to run it locally.
- [Field notes](https://itsdavis.com/DOPPLERGEIST/examples.md): Real recordings, the Livermore example, and the limits of the reported results.
- [Method](https://itsdavis.com/DOPPLERGEIST/how-it-works.md): Acoustic discovery, propagation modeling, flight matching, and how to read the results.
